caption:
Is your final-year project a product or just a demo?

Three common mistakes: no tests, it only runs on your laptop, and no reasons behind your design choices. Swipe for the fixes.

Want mentoring in Bengaluru to build it properly? Registration link in bio.

slides.title: 3 mistakes that make your final-year project look like a demo
1. No tests
slides.body: Without tests, nobody can trust your code. Even ten good tests show you understand how it behaves.

slides.title: 2. It only runs on your laptop
slides.body: If examiners cannot open it, they cannot judge it. Deploy it and add a README with clear run steps.

slides.title: 3. No reasons for your choices
slides.body: Why this database? Why this model? Write down the trade-offs. Viva questions often start here.

slides.title: The fix: build it like a product
slides.body: Tests, deployment, documentation, and a clear explanation of every choice.

slides.title: Want help building it properly?
slides.body: Mentoring for final-year CS, IS, AI and ML students in Bengaluru.
